description: Returns ready-to-open links that start a new project from one template's build prompt in Lovable, v0 and Bolt; nothing is created until the user opens a link. Use this to hand a template to a hosted AI builder; use get_template_prompt instead to build it yourself in the current project. Same access rule and fair-use cap as get_template_prompt: free templates need any signed-in account, a Pro template is included with Pro and Lifetime or spends one Prompt Pack credit on first use (later calls are free). The prompt is embedded in each link, so v0 and Bolt links are omitted when longer than 7,000 characters; the Lovable link is always present.

slug.description: Template slug, exactly as returned by search (kind templates).

name: open_in_builder
